environment: Node VM + minimal DOM + native Canvas; not a browser

Abel, Yara, Nilo and Rute each appear once, have appropriate activity destinations, respond to the player and retain matched English–Portuguese speech.
120 seconds per map keep new NPC and pet routes clear; all six dogs have nearby resident ownership and persistent field notes visible in the notebook. All 18 map access checks pass.
